title: The inverse images of a locally finite family of closed subsets under an arbitrary morphism are again locally finite
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that pulling back a locally finite family of closed subsets along an arbitrary morphism between schemes locally of finite type preserves local finiteness (statement lines 2169-2178). The proof tests local finiteness on an arbitrary quasi-compact open of the source, finds a quasi-compact open of the target containing its image, and compares the two index sets. The comparison of index sets through a quasi-compact intermediate is the substance, so the claim is H2.
